This fixture represents the existing Free selection without inventing an official fee or policy. Reuse this composition with the actual confirmed Free/Required/Pending value, service identity and server actor/time. annotation: Required-fee contextual receipt, separate from the Free G04.7 receipt. The primary action opens only an existing payment-choice design preview; it creates no payment or charge and leaves provider actions disabled. Runtime may show this receipt/handoff only after submission, authoritative fee configuration, amount and ownership are verified; if an amount is unavailable, retain the blocked configuration state instead. Replace unloaded em dashes with actual server data, never a client-supplied amount. Keep request progress separate from payment. Connect from a required-fee confirmed-submission review fixture only; no automatic busy-to-success transition, invented fee or fabricated reference.
